projects.title: Microsoft HoloLens & Windows Holographic
projects.description: On the HoloLens project I have developed feature code for Windows Holographic in addition to my my primary role developing data analytics infrastructure. I've helped engineer the tools and aggregate the data that Microsoft uses to make key business decisions regarding build quality and customer experience on holographic devices. I've had a hand in developing nearly every piece of the telemetry/data reporting pipeline from product code to telemetry processing to internal dashboards with data visualizations.
